Quick Stop Tuesday Night Ride

Marquette, MI · Mountain bike · Gravel

Quick Stop Tuesday Night Ride is a mountain bike and gravel group ride in Marquette, MI. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Behind Quick Stop Bike Shop. Pace: moderate.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate.
Check
Look at @quickstopbikeshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Quick Stop Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A moderate mountain bike ride on mostly blue-square trails with a few black diamonds. Early spring and late fall it turns into a gravel ride, and sometimes a klunker ride. Check the shop or its Facebook page.
